content.text:
I've submitted index 12, but all three measurements were very weak, so it's probably far from the best composition in the library.

I used the three merit measurements on the three corners of the library, each richest in one cation:

| Index | Composition | Photocurrent |
|---|---|---|
| 12 (submitted) | Co-rich: Ca 0.14, Co 0.70, Mn 0.16 | 1e-8 A |
| 123 | Mn-rich: Ca 0.16, Co 0.20, Mn 0.63 | 0 A |
| 17 | Ca-rich: Ca 0.53, Co 0.32, Mn 0.15 | −7e-8 A (negative, current flowing the wrong way for a photoanode) |

**What held the run back:**
- **Phase list not read:** `list_phases` returned more text than I could read with the tools I had. I never saw the real phase IDs, so the model checks used two guessed IDs, and only one was confirmed as Mn3O4.
- **Models didn't help choose:** both predicted band gaps (0.02 eV and 0.94 eV) are below the 2.06 eV photon energy, so light absorption doesn't separate one region from another. MACE only confirmed that Mn3O4 is stable.
- **Search too sparse:** the GP model had no data at the start, and three measurements across 183 candidates is very little. The middle of the library and the Mn–Ca edge were never tested.
- **XRD unused:** I didn't spend any of the 5 XRD measurements.
